messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2

4.4.2. Lifting machinery Lifting machinery must be accompanied by instructions containing information on: (a) the technical characteristics of the machinery, and in particular: — the maximum working load and, where appropriate, a copy of the load plate or load table described in the second paragraph of section 4.3.3, — the reactions at the supports or anchors and, where appropriate, characteristics of the tracks, — where appropriate, the definition and the means of installation of the ballast; (b) the contents of the logbook, if the latter is not supplied with the machinery; (c) advice for use, particularly to offset the lack of direct vision of the load by the operator; (d) where appropriate, a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests carried out by or for the manufacturer or his authorised representative; (e) for machinery which is not assembled on the premises of the manufacturer in the form in which it is to be used, the necessary instructions for performing the measures referred to in section 4.1.3 before it is first put into service.

response.text:
Lifting machinery | mustBeAccompaniedBy | instructions containing information on the technical characteristics of the machinery | "" | Lifting machinery must be accompanied by instructions containing information on: (a) the technical characteristics of the machinery
Lifting machinery instructions | includeMaximumWorkingLoad | the maximum working load | where appropriate, a copy of the load plate or load table is also included | the maximum working load and, where appropriate, a copy of the load plate or load table described in the second paragraph of section 4.3.3
Lifting machinery instructions | includeSupportReactions | the reactions at the supports or anchors | "" | the reactions at the supports or anchors and, where appropriate, characteristics of the tracks
Lifting machinery instructions | includeBallastInformation | the definition and means of installation of the ballast | where appropriate | where appropriate, the definition and the means of installation of the ballast
Lifting machinery instructions | includeLogbookContents | the contents of the logbook | if the logbook is not supplied with the machinery | the contents of the logbook, if the latter is not supplied with the machinery
Lifting machinery instructions | includeAdviceForUse | advice for use, particularly to offset the lack of direct vision of the load by the operator | "" | advice for use, particularly to offset the lack of direct vision of the load by the operator
Lifting machinery instructions | includeTestReport | a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests carried out by or for the manufacturer or his authorised representative | where appropriate | where appropriate, a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests carried out by or for the manufacturer or his authorised representative
Lifting machinery instructions | includeInstallationInstructions | the necessary instructions for performing the measures referred to in section 4.1.3 before first use | machinery is not assembled on the manufacturer's premises in the form in which it is to be used | for machinery which is not assembled on the premises of the manufacturer in the form in which it is to be used, the necessary instructions for performing the measures referred to in section 4.1.3 before it is first put into service
